# Install `block-selection` — Block Selection — multi-select + bulk delete

> Framework-agnostic multi-selection for any vertical list (Notion-style blocks, table rows, cards).

📚 Knowledge base : https://resource.rahmanef.com/llms.txt
📦 Slice detail   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/slices/block-selection
🧠 JSON catalog   : https://resource.rahmanef.com/api/knowledge?slice=block-selection
🤖 Prompt page    : https://resource.rahmanef.com/agents/block-selection

## 1. Install

```bash
npx rahman-resources add block-selection
# alias: npx rr add block-selection
```

## 2. What it ships

- tags: `ui`, `selection`, `multi-select`, `bulk`, `notion`, `blocks`, `list`, `primitive`

## 3. Wire it up

Run `npx rr add block-selection`. Zero deps. Wrap your list in `<BlockSelectionProvider onBulkDelete={(ids) => removeMany(ids)}>` and each item in `<SelectableBlock id={item.id} orderedIds={allIds}>…</SelectableBlock>`. Click an item's top/bottom edge strip to select (Shift = range, Cmd/Ctrl = toggle); Backspace/Delete bulk-deletes (when focus is outside a contentEditable), Escape clears, and a floating `N selected · Delete · Clear` toolbar appears. Read selection state anywhere under the provider via `useBlockSelection()`. The slice owns ONLY the id set — you own the data + perform the delete. Generic: works on table rows or cards too, not just notion blocks.

## Rules of engagement

- shadcn-only UI primitives. No raw `<button>` / `<dialog>` / native date or file inputs.
- 200-line hard cap per source file (extract neighbours when over).
